about: Real engines of the real cars Motor Town vehicles are based on (step 5b). Pillar 1: these specs are the base of the simulation. 'checked' lists the fields confirmed against 'sources'; every other non-null value is from general knowledge and still to be checked. null = not found yet (the pipeline derives it by one fixed rule, never per-engine tuning). Units: mm, hp (SAE as published for that year), N*m, rpm.
fields: layout I/V/F(flat)/VR; bank_angle deg; cycle 4 or 2; valvetrain side-valve/OHV/SOHC/DOHC; induction carb-1bbl/carb-2bbl/carb-4bbl/carb-multi/TBI/MPFI/SFI/ITB/DI/diesel-mech/diesel-unit/diesel-common-rail; aspiration NA/turbo/twin-turbo/supercharged/roots-blown
